result.title: Doob-Based Generative Policy Optimization
result.summary: Diffusion and flow models provide expressive policy classes for robotic and sequential decision-making systems. However, their action likelihoods are generally intractable, limiting the direct use of widely adopted policy optimization methods such as PPO and GRPO. We propose Doob Policy Optimization (DoobPO), a framework that leverages Doob's $h$-transform for likelihood-free reinforcement learning fine-tuning of generative policies. DoobPO separates policy improvement from generative policy learning. It first learns a lightweight ratio model that represents the desired policy update, and then distills the resulting ratio-tilted target policy into the generative policy via conditional drift matching. This formulation applies uniformly to both diffusion and flow policies and supports a broad family of policy improvement rules, including PPO and GRPO. We prove that the practical conditional drift matching objective is gradient-equivalent to the ideal Doob drift matching objective. We further show that the induced diffusion process solves an endpoint-constrained stochastic optimal control problem. This establishes that it achieves the minimum-energy modification required to realize the desired policy tilt. Across MuJoCo continuous-control benchmarks, DoobPO achieves strong performance against competitive diffusion- and flow-policy baselines, showing a principled and practical route to RL fine-tuning for generative policies.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 DoobPO：利用 Doob h-变换，在动作似然不可积的情况下对扩散与 flow 策略做强化学习微调，先用轻量 ratio model 表示策略改进，再通过 conditional drift matching 把倾斜后的目标策略蒸馏进生成策略，并在 MuJoCo 连续控制上验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「似然不可解时用比值模型加漂移匹配完成奖励驱动的策略改进」思路，可能为多步 latent 推理轨迹的 RL 式训练与贡献分配提供可核查的借鉴，但论文本身面向机器人控制，未涉及视觉推理。
